criterion: A license covers the code and the writing (memo H2)
checked_by: script: LICENSE at the repository root

criterion: A version number in the results header and a CHANGELOG.md whose newest entry is that version
A model card on models/MODEL-CARD-TEMPLATE.md with all seven elements (answers; cannot answer; evidence map; mechanisms and research basis; limits; status; owner)
checked_by: script: the template's headings and the status and owner line

criterion: Every input in a parameter file on models/schema/parameters.py: value; unit; effective year; evidence ID or source URL; a range for each assumption
A validation table on models/schema/validation.py written by the test code: every benchmark run and every miss explained
One command runs the model from a fresh clone with public or documented data
checked_by: review (a fresh-clone job once H2b wires one)

criterion: The model's tests run in the project's checks (run-all.sh or .github/scripts/run-checks.sh)
checked_by: script: the tests column against both scripts

criterion: A machine-written run log: at least one RUN- row in models/runs.csv for the model
The not-an-official-score line on every results file (the results header)
checked_by: script: models/schema/results.py on the results column

criterion: A known-issues list on the card
checked_by: script: a 'Known issues' heading on the card

criterion: The project's reviewer has tried to break it (the release review)
checked_by: review: a link to the review comment
